# Flakes

My personal nixos/home-manager configurations.

# Flakes on GitHub

Please note that GitHub is not the forge that Flakes is being developed with.
Flakes is developed using Radicle. Therefore, issues cannot be created on
GitHub, but only via Radicle directly. However, pull requests are still
accepted.

To view existing issues and patches with your web browser, navigate to
[radicle.network](https://radicle.network/nodes/rosa.radicle.network/rad%3Azd6cNdwUA58H71AXf6cvspv3X1R2).
